title: Launching of 50th Round of Quarterly Services and Infrastructure Outlook Survey (SIOS) Q2:2026-27
description: The Reserve Bank has launched the 50th round of the quarterly Services and Infrastructure Outlook Survey (SIOS) for the reference period July-September 2026. The survey assesses the business situation for the current quarter (Q2:2026-27) from selected companies in the services and infrastructure sectors in India and their expectations for the ensuing quarter (Q3:2026-27) based on qualitative responses on a set of indicators pertaining to demand conditions, financial conditions, employment condit
